name: Camping 101: Alchemy

angles.text: Alliance alchemists traveling across Teldrassil are directed to Dolanaar to learn magical camp craft for wilderness survival.
As a night elf herbalist or alchemist in Dolanaar, you can join natural botany with camp craft to support spellcasters in the wild.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Alchemy teaches novice alchemists in Dolanaar to use their craft at camp. They learn to make useful wilderness fittings with their potion-making skills.
Cyndra Kindwhisper teaches alchemists in Dolanaar, the night elf settlement on Teldrassil. She instructs those who have shown skill in brewing and crafting specialized camping items.

aliases: what does a mana well do
faq.answer: A Mana Well is an alchemist's camp installation. It offers arcane refreshment to spellcasters and healers who need to replenish their reserves on the road.
You travel to Dolanaar, a night elf village in central Teldrassil. It is a hub for young adventurers and tradecraft trainers leaving Shadowglen.
faq.q: Where does this quest take you?

faq.answer: Traveling healers and spellcasters benefit most from Mana Wells. The refreshing fonts help replenish them on taxing journeys far from towns.
faq.q: Who benefits from an alchemist's camp installation?

aliases: when can i learn the mana well
faq.answer: Alchemists must first show skill in basic brewing and potion craft. Then Cyndra Kindwhisper teaches them to assemble camping fittings such as a Mana Well.
faq.q: What is required before learning to craft a Mana Well?

sections.body: Alchemists learn to carry their craft beyond the workbench. Cyndra Kindwhisper shows them how to make useful camp fittings that can sustain a traveling party on long journeys through the wild.
sections.title: Field Craft for Alchemists

sections.body: In Dolanaar, alchemists who know the basics can seek Cyndra Kindwhisper. She teaches them to set up a Mana Well at camp. Its refreshing magic helps healers and spellcasters replenish their mana far from taverns and settlements.
sections.title: The Mana Well of Dolanaar

summary: In Dolanaar, Cyndra Kindwhisper teaches alchemists how to tend a campsite. Her lesson joins potion craft with wilderness survival and shows how to make a Mana Well for traveling healers and casters.
